title: Enforce controller ownership and keep advice distinct from approval
narrative: Possession of a run id alone must not confer control. An intruder controller cannot resume; ordinary guidance cannot satisfy final-approval authority — that remains `fangore_insp_approval_interrupt`. Tracks R-IOC-AUTH[^insp-ioc-07].
implementation: `LeaseControllerAuth` / `GeneratorControllerAuth` on resume/cancel; `requested_authority=final_approval` raises PermissionError pointing hosts at ApprovalInterrupt.
validation: Harness `durable_generator` via `scenario.yaml`. Hard expects intruder rejected, final approval rejected, inspect still ok for owner.
